name: What is the process for getting an estimate for residential reroofing?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting an estimate for residential reroofing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for getting a residential reroofing estimate with Discounted Roofing Co. begins with scheduling a free, no-obligation consultation. During this visit, our team will conduct a thorough inspection of your current roof, assess its condition, measure the area, and discuss your material preferences and budget. We will then provide a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, material options, estimated timeline, and a transparent cost breakdown. This comprehensive approach ensures you have all the information needed to make an informed decision without any pressure.
acceptedAnswer.description: To get an estimate, schedule a free consultation. We'll inspect your roof, discuss options, and provide a detailed proposal with scope, timeline, and costs.
